sloka: प्रियम् त्वामप्रियम् वक्तुम् वाणी नास्योपपर्तते ।तदवश्यम् त्वया कार्यम् यदनेनाश्रुतम् मम ॥२-१८-२१॥
transliteration: priyam tvāmapriyam vaktum vāṇī nāsyopapartate ।tadavaśyam tvayā kāryam yadanenāśrutam mama ॥2-18-21॥

translations.english: The goddess of speech does not permit him to say an unpleasant thing to you for you are his beloved son. So you must fulfil the promise he has made to me.
